checks.name: Speaking exam schema
Declared count matches the bank
Unique item identities
Every exam format carries the real preparation and speaking time
Every format explains what the task actually asks for
Every item points at a format that exists
All three IELTS Speaking parts are present
All four TOEFL Speaking tasks are present
Part 2 items carry a four-bullet cue card
checks.details: kartu IELTS Part 2 selalu punya empat butir, dan butir terakhir yang paling sering terlewat

checks.name: Part 3 items carry discussion follow-ups
checks.details: Part 3 adalah diskusi, bukan satu pertanyaan

checks.name: Integrated tasks carry the source they must be summarised from
checks.details: tugas integrated tanpa sumber hanya jadi soal opini

checks.name: Adapted formats admit what was changed
checks.details: aslinya memakai audio; menyajikannya tertulis harus dinyatakan, bukan didiamkan

checks.name: The bank states it predicts no band and judges no pronunciation
checks.details: FIEZEL tidak memprediksi band IELTS atau skor TOEFL, dan TIDAK menilai pelafalan. Yang bisa dihitung dari transkrip hanyalah cakupan gagasan; sisanya perlu dibaca guru atau AI.

checks.name: Rubric follows the IELTS Speaking criterion families
Every criterion is a full 0-4 band set
Each criterion says whether a machine can score it, and why
Pronunciation is explicitly NOT machine-scored
checks.details: skor pengenalan ucapan naik-turun karena mikrofon dan kebisingan; memakainya sebagai nilai pelafalan menghukum murid atas perangkatnya

checks.name: Exactly one criterion is claimed as machine-scored
Every item keeps the coverage-only scoring claim
checks.details: klaim penilaian tidak boleh berubah diam-diam per item

checks.name: No item persists raw audio or transcript
checks.details: kontrak privasi Skills Lab berlaku sama untuk latihan ujian

checks.name: The addon loads the exam bank without making it fatal
checks.details: Skills Lab harian tidak boleh mati hanya karena berkas latihan ujian belum ada

checks.name: The exam domain is a real session domain
checks.details: domain baru harus punya renderer sendiri

checks.name: Exam sessions are level-scoped like everything else
checks.details: kontrak level m025-136 berlaku di sini juga

checks.name: Voice controls are bound from one shared place
checks.details: menyalin pengikatan dua kali berarti perbaikan privasi hanya sampai ke salah satunya

checks.name: The exam renderer shows the timing contract to the learner
checks.details: menyembunyikan waktunya berarti melatih soal ujian tanpa tekanan ujiannya

checks.name: The exam bank is precached for offline use
